rust_summary: the registry name of a numeric id (`native_registry_name`), so a mod can name the items, data components, entity types, sounds and particles that `native_client_packet`'s packets carry as numbers.
doc_summary: `native_registry_name(registry, id)` (`host.registry_name`) gives the name of a protocol id in a registry (`minecraft:item`, `minecraft:entity_type`, ...). Bundles need "hooks": @API:registry_name@.
